subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan — SignalSphere
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Josh Park <josh@signalsphere.com>, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-27T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan — SignalSphere

Hi Josh / Elaine —

Great to meet you both today. Quick recap and a proposed, time-boxed POC to validate SignalSphere's main objectives we discussed: reducing triage time on incoming support cases and improving knowledge-base retrieval relevance. Below is a lightweight evaluation plan we can start against this week.

High-level goals (what success looks like)
- Automated triage accuracy: >= 60% of cases routed to correct queue in week 1, trend to >= 75% by week 4 (we'll use sampling + label set)
- KB retrieval precision: utility score >= 0.65 on the internal evaluator we discussed (see eval outline)
- Latency: 95th percentile generation latency <= 450ms for your median request profile

Proposed POC (4 weeks)
- Week 0 (this week): access & scope — provide a sanitized sample of 1k recent support tickets and 200 KB articles; sign MPA and share procurement stub
- Week 1: onboarding & baseline — Redwood spins a dedicated trial instance, run baseline evals, small tuning pass; PoC owner: Karthik
- Week 2–3: iterative evaluation — run live batch of ~500 queries, evaluate routing and KB matches, implement suggested batching/quantization settings to control cost
- Week 4: acceptance run & handoff — final run, change log, cost/latency report, recommended production config

Ownership
- Redwood technical lead: karthik.iyer@redwood.com (env, model selection, runbook)
- Redwood CS: monica.patel@redwood.com (success criteria, meeting cadence)
- SignalSphere tech lead: Josh (provisioning data, verification labels)

Ask / next steps
1) Please confirm the sample dataset delivery timeline (sanitized preferred) and who will be the SignalSphere PO for procurement.
2) If the goals above look misaligned, flag the thresholds you'd like adjusted — I can update the evaluation sheet and resend.
3) We'll attach the eval outline and a mutual action plan for signatures.

Attachments: 20270627_signalsphere_eval_outline.pdf, mutual_action_plan_signalsphere.xlsx

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20 minute sync if you want to walk through the plan.

Camila Reyes
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
From: Josh Park <josh@signalsphere.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Elaine Morris <elaine.m@signalsphere.com>
Date: 2027-06-27T15:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan — SignalSphere

Thanks Camila — appreciate the structured plan. A few quick notes from our side after the demo: 

- Triage accuracy target: can we start at a slightly lower threshold for week 1 (50%) and aim to 70% by week 4? We want to ensure we don't overcommit given label noise.
- KB precision: the 0.65 utility score is reasonable; can you include the exact metric definition and an example scoring spreadsheet in the eval_outline?
- Procurement: Elaine is our procurement lead — she'll need a stub PO and a short SOW. I attached a procurement checklist and noted the SOC2 question (they want the SOC2 Type II report or equivalent evidence).

I can get the sanitized 1k tickets by EOD Friday if that works. Elaine — looping you for procurement cadence and legal questions.

Josh
Director, TechOps — SignalSphere

--- Attachment: signalsphere_procurement_stub.pdf (procurement checklist) ---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Josh Park <josh@signalsphere.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-27T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan — SignalSphere

Josh — thanks for the quick reply and the procurement stub. A few technical commitments from our side: 

1) Dedicated trial instance: we'll provision a single-node dedicated instance in us-west for the POC with isolation controls. Expected provision time: 24–48 hours after we receive the sanitized dataset and signed MPA.
2) Baseline & evaluator: I'll upload the evaluation rubric and scoring sheet to the Drive link Camila shared; that will include the formula we use for the KB utility score (precision@k + relevance weighting).
3) Data handling: for the ticket sample we'll accept a CSV export (ticket_id, timestamp, text, queue_label). We'll provide a redaction guide; if you need, Redwood can run a redaction pass under the MPA (we'll need a signed DPA addendum).
4) Owners & cadence: I'll run weekly check-ins (30 minutes) on Tuesdays and share interim reports in the drive. Monica will coordinate acceptance criteria sign-off.

If Josh can confirm dataset delivery by Friday and Elaine can confirm procurement timeline, I can trigger provisioning immediately after.

Karthik Iyer
Sr. Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
From: Josh Park <josh@signalsphere.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Elaine Morris <elaine.m@signalsphere.com>, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-27T17:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan — SignalSphere

All good — we accept the adjusted triage thresholds (50% → 70% target) and the provisioning plan. Elaine will circulate a PO stub and our legal will expect the SOC2 evidence; she and I will confirm the procurement timeline by tomorrow.

I’ll aim to deliver the sanitized ticket CSV on Friday morning. Please go ahead and provision the trial instance once you have the MPA signed; Elaine — copying you to confirm next steps on the procurement doc and legal contact.

Josh

--- Attachment: signalsphere_procurement_stub.pdf (attached earlier) ---
